create_laplace_distribution: create a Laplace distribution with specified loc (mean) and scale parameters using torch tensors
sample_laplace_distribution: sample random values from a Laplace distribution given loc and scale parameters
compute_laplace_log_prob: compute log probability of values under a Laplace distribution with given loc and scale
compute_laplace_cdf: compute the cumulative distribution function for values under a Laplace distribution
compute_laplace_entropy: compute the differential entropy of a Laplace distribution from its scale parameter
